statement: Let k ≥ 1, and let z1, . . . , zk have pairwise distinct real coordinates or pairwise distinct imaginary coordinates. For εi ∈ {+, −} and moving mesh faces zi,δ → zi, lim δ↓0 E k Y i=1 δ−1 Dεi δ hδ(zi,δ) = X π Y {i,j}∈π Cεi,εj (zi, zj), (6.30) where the sum is over pairings, is zero for odd k, and C++(z, ξ) = − κ (z − ξ)2 , C−−(z, ξ) = − κ (z̄ − ¯ ξ)2 , C+−(z, ξ) = C−+(z, ξ) = 0. (6.31) 67 Convergence is uniform on compact subsets of either separated-time region. By linearity the corresponding assertion holds for all products of the real centered derivatives δ−1Dx,δ and δ−1Dy,δ. These are the off-diagonal derivatives of the Gaussian covariance Kκ(z, ξ) = −2κ log |z − ξ|. (6.32)
